notes: Honeywell's commercial IP camera lines span multiple OEM origins. The 35 Series (current) uses two parallel documented RTSP formats: the .sdp form (/live1s<N>.sdp) and the numeric path form (/live/1/<N>); both are documented in the same official user guide and are functionally equivalent. The Performance Series uses /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0/1 — this is the Dahua OEM RTSP format, confirming the Performance Series is Dahua-based. The EQUIP series (older HCD554IP family) docs were not accessible in full; no official RTSP path confirmed for that line. Default RTSP port is 554 for all documented lines. For 35 Series, Camera ID is always 1 for single-channel cameras; Streaming ID 1=main, 2=sub, 3=third.
